items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: Gloria Swanson was showing. Did you see that? ... Gloria Swanson, ain't it?

ctx.x: Did you have a lot of boyfriends?

No, I didn't. A lot of different boys. The first boyfriend I had was a man I married. All the other boys didn't mean a thing to me, just dancing. Good times. Where would you go besides dances? It's all to the movies. Then you just have to sit there and look until the talking movies came. Years ago, they wasn't talking. You just have to be written on the screen like they showed last night. Gloria Swanson was showing. Did you see that? Where she was showing private movies? No, I didn't see that. I got a secret. She…
Well, on that band that she's... She's very glamorous. That you hired for $2 East. Didn't you all have them several times after that?
